fusions.name: Crack from the Reeds
fusions.desc: Looses a shot from the waterline that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. It is always a critical hit and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Pellet Spread
fusions.desc: Looses 5 pellets at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage and knocking its target back 2 tiles. They have 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Past the Armour
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
